question_text: A training register has fields LearnerID,LearnerName,Level,EventID,CourseTitle,Provider,EventDate,Fee,Completed. LearnerID determines LearnerName and Level; EventID determines CourseTitle,Provider,EventDate and Fee; the pair LearnerID/EventID determines Completed. Construct a3NF schema, indicating primary and foreign keys.
adaptation_rationale: Original table does not state all functional dependencies; supplied dependencies remove ambiguity about event cost and qualification/provider relationships.
